title: Parcel Delivery Snapshot
description: Published by parcel-service on routing key parcel.delivery-snapshot.v1 when a courier is assigned (PATCH /api/parcels/{id}/courier). Carries the delivery details the courier needs; courier-service stores them in its own read model (courier.delivery-events queue). Sent only for assigned parcels so receiver contact details reach courier-service only when a courier will deliver the parcel.

merchantUserId.description: Identity user id of the merchant that owns the parcel; null for customer parcels.
